# A message that does not require an answer

Sent Mum a photograph from the allotment with no question attached. She enjoyed it and did not feel she had a task waiting on her phone. Most of my messages request an update. [[Care arrangements]] is full of coordination and almost empty of ordinary company. A better care system should leave room for conversations that do not improve the system.
